items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will not be placed on IR after imaging and specialist consults on dislocated left elbow; consensus is week-to-week with aim for return ASAP. Ruled out only for this weekend vs Seahawks.
items.why: Imaging evaluated, multiple specialists consulted; joint consensus week-to-week.
items.implication: Marcus Mariota starts Week 3; Daniels not season-ending. Monitor return timeline.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for Washington pass-catchers short-term with Mariota.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) DNP for second straight day. McVay: 'We'll see… He’s not making great progress.' Status in doubt for Week 3 vs DEN.
items.why: Hip injury; limited/no progress in practice; McVay comments.
items.implication: Likely miss another game; Adams continues as primary WR.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams elevated routes/targets/production without Nacua.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) DNP second straight day. May miss Sunday vs Colts.
items.implication: Schultz and others elevated in Houston passing game.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz high route/target share without Collins.

items.text: After Rhamondre Stevenson first-quarter fumble, TreVeyon Henderson led Patriots backfield 65% snaps and out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Outlook improved but Stevenson still ranked ahead Week 3; gap narrowed.
items.why: Snap/touch split post-fumble; pass-pro trust issues remain for Henderson.
items.implication: Henderson more viable; monitor split. Stevenson still preferred short-term.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead despite usage.

items.text: Drake London in 12 career games with Michael Penix: over 20 PPR pts, 35% target share, 97 rec yds/game.
items.implication: London boom potential with Penix back (TNF evidence of revival).
items.opportunity: High target share and production with Penix.

items.text: With Nico Collins out, Dalton Schultz targeted on 30% routes, team-high 28% target share. Faces Colts allowing 4th-most TE yards.
items.implication: Schultz strong TE start if Collins out.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Results in missed games: 5-35-3 vs JAX 2025; 8-195-2 vs NYG.
items.why: Route/target share data + recent production without Nacua.
items.implication: Adams WR1 upside if Nacua out again; must-start.
items.opportunity: High target rate and TD production in Nacua absences.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected on IR (only 5 games in 3 seasons). Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
items.implication: Hubbard clear RB1 Carolina; waiver/handcuff value.
items.opportunity: Full lead back snaps/carries for Hubbard.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) not full practice; first hurt Aug 20 joint practice, aggravated Week 1 after 5-150-1 half, hasn't practiced full since. Ravens travel to Brazil.
items.implication: May miss another; Ravens WR depth tested in Brazil.

items.text: Expect Brock Bowers (knee/meniscus) back Week 3 vs Saints; practicing (limited), good chance to debut 2026.
items.implication: Elite TE1 if active; Mayer role reduces.
items.opportunity: Bowers top target/routes in LV offense.

items.text: MarShawn Lloyd averaging 38% snaps/10.5 touches through 2 weeks; same RZ touches as Brooks; fewer rushes than Kaleb Johnson Week 2. Levitan questions if ceded to Johnson.
Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Prop line + Dallas rush defense weakness.
items.opportunity: Volume and efficiency vs poor run D.

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards. LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.opportunity: High target share and deep threat vs weak secondary.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX allows only 55 rush ypg, 3.2 YPC.
items.conflict: Prior lead role but usage declining.
